description: Set the neighborhoods of one city side by side: the distance to the nearest rail or metro station, and how many parks, supermarkets, pharmacies, schools, restaurants and cafes lie within 1 km of each neighborhood centre. Counted from OpenStreetMap; the answer carries the date of the map data.

city.description: City name, "name, country" when the name is shared, or GeoLocale's id for the city, for example "lisbon".

limit.description: How many neighborhoods to return. Default 30.

sort_by.description: Order by one measure: transit is closest station first, the others are most first. Omit for the order of the city page.

name: compare_neighborhoods
title: Compare a city's neighborhoods
